title: QueryPanTiltOperationalParameters
description:
This message is query the per-joint operational parameters.  
                    The presence vector is used to indicate which fields are desired in the corresponding 
                    report message; however, this request may not be honored if the underlying implementation 
                    does not support those fields.

PresenceVector.comment: See Report Pan Tilt Operational Parameters for bitwise interpretation of the PV.
